text:
Maria: kicking off regional rollout: sequence US -> EU -> APAC. targeting v3.2 (pin) for canaries. change window 02:00-05:00 UTC. any objections?
Sam: no objections, I'll monitor SLOs and latency.
DeployBot: launch: canary-us-west-2 v3.2 pinned, 4 replicas, warmup=5m. logs streaming.
Sam: seeing initial p50=78ms p95=190ms p99=360ms, errors=0.6% — looks healthy.
Ollie: confirm quota + warm-pool allocated for US?
InfraBot: quota check: us-west-2 warm_pool=4/4 allocated, burst capacity=2 reserved.
Maria: progressing to EU after 10m stable window. tagging @Kaori for EU specifics.
Kaori: EU needs pin to v3.2 but keep v3.1-quant as immediate fallback; prefer lower concurrency (max_concurrency=8) because of memory variance.
DeployBot: starting canary-eu-central-1 v3.2 (concurrency=8).
Sam: EU initial metrics p50=120ms p95=400ms p99=520ms, errors=1.0% — p99 higher but still below our 700ms threshold.
Kaori: KV cache miss rate bumped to 12% on EU nodes after canary kick; investigating.
Ollie: logs show spike in cold-KV hits after replica rotation.
Maria: decision: HOLD EU expansion, apply split routing to reduce blast radius.
DeployBot: routing update: eu traffic split -> 60% v3.2, 40% v3.1-quant.
Sam: applied concurrency cap and enabled prefix caching for EU canary. monitoring windows at 1m.
Kaori: p99 trending down to ~430ms after cache priming, errors steady at 0.9%. good. :thumbsup:
Maria: DO NOT start APAC until EU is stable for 30m. moving APAC to queued.
Noah: I'll prep the release notes addendum documenting the fallback and routing split.
--- ~40 minutes later ---
Sam: starting APAC warmup now (ap-northeast-1) with v3.2 pinned per plan.
DeployBot: canary-apac started: 3 replicas, warmup=6m.
Sam: APAC metrics: p50=210ms p95=780ms p99=910ms, errors=3.2% — crossing rollback thresholds.
Kaori: that's above the rollback rule: p99>700ms for 2 consecutive 1m windows OR errors>2% -> immediate rollback.
Ollie: KV miss not the culprit here; looks like kernel scheduling + disk IO on some instances.
Maria: rollback APAC to v3.1-quant. stop further rollouts.
DeployBot: rollback initiated for ap-northeast-1 -> routing shift 100% -> v3.1-quant. deprovisioning pending.
InfraBot: releasing 3 canary instances, reclaiming warm_pool.
Sam: post-rollback metrics returning to p99~420ms, errors=0.7% on apac after rollback.
Maria: good catch. we'll run a short incident review and update the rollout runbook: add APAC-specific kernel-compatibility check and increase warmup there to 10m.
Noah: filing incident and dressing release notes now — will include timeline, trigger, actions, and follow-ups.
Kaori: action items: (1) add kernel+IO preflight for APAC, (2) add KV priming step to EU expansion plan, (3) document routing split template.
Maria: thanks team. requeue APAC for next maintenance window after infra fixes.
DeployBot: deploy summary: US ok, EU partial (split 60/40), APAC rolled back -> overall rollout paused.
Noah: noted. I'll update the ticket and post the summary to #product-release.
Maria: closing thread for now. will reopen if anything changes. :white_check_mark:
